per_level.qualification: WCL fit relative to unweakened +2; rounding and Mythic 0 baseline are not established. Blizzard's rates are historical.

fortified.qualification: Blizzard describes damage as up to 20%, not a universally proven fixed multiplier.

tyrannical.qualification: Blizzard describes boss and minion damage as up to 15%; WCL comparison did not establish a universal multiplier.
